narrative.overview:
NOCTIS is not decorated: it is constructed. The visual language belongs to Japanese spatial architecture, not to the fine dining conventions of Mediterranean luxury. Surfaces have mass. Silence is structural, not incidental. When you enter this design system, you are entering a space that was built with the same precision and restraint that governs each dish on the menu.

The system is dark by physical necessity, not by aesthetic trend. The darkness is the room. The gold is not precious, it is mineral. The cream appears only where breath is needed: a pause in a long corridor.

This system explicitly rejects every signal of classic Italian fine dining and every SaaS dark-mode reflex. The references are closer to the surface quality of a Kengo Kuma interior or a Brutus magazine spread.
keyCharacteristics: Zero border-radius across all interactive and structural elements
Single typeface (DM Sans) spanning weight 200 to 800
Tempered Gold used as punctuation, never wallpaper
Flat surfaces — no shadows — depth via overlay opacity and gradient fades
Entrance animations feel like physics: expo out, no bounce, no spring

rules.name: The One Touch Rule
rules.body: Tempered Gold appears on fewer than 10% of any surface. When gold appears everywhere, it appears nowhere.

rules.name: The Temperature Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is warm-tinted toward gold's hue (75° in OKLCH). Cold neutrals are forbidden.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: No typeface other than DM Sans is permitted. Contrast is expressed through weight, size, or letter-spacing within the family.

rules.name: The Weight Ratio Rule
rules.body: Adjacent hierarchy levels must differ by at least one full weight step.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Box-shadow is prohibited. Depth is expressed through tonal contrast and overlay.

rules.name: The Overlay Rule
rules.body: Photography is never shown unmodified. All full-bleed images carry at least one overlay layer.

dos: Do use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for all entrance animations
Do apply prefers-reduced-motion to suppress animations while preserving layout
Do tint every neutral toward hue 75° in OKLCH
Do use DM Sans weight 300 for all body copy
Do separate sections with background color alternation, not horizontal rules
Do place meaningful alt text on all photography — describe the atmosphere
Do use will-change: transform on parallax elements
donts: Don't use border-radius on any element — zero is the doctrine
Don't add box-shadow to any element
Don't use Tempered Gold as a background on large surfaces
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient
Don't produce anything that reads as Italian fine dining: white marble, ornamental serif on cream, candlelight photography
Don't use ease-in-out for UI transitions — ease-out only
